name: arbihunt-scanner
description: Local read-only cross-exchange crypto arbitrage scanner with 25 exchange adapters

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @arbihunt/backend" "npm run dev -w @arbihunt/frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @arbihunt/shared --if-present && npm run test -w @arbihunt/backend --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @arbihunt/shared --if-present && npm run typecheck -w @arbihunt/backend --if-present && npm run typecheck -w @arbihunt/frontend --if-present
